text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was right after training finished—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Will you be staying late today as well?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll just work a little bit more.
Yeah, I'll work just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, my body is feeling tired. But if it's for Manhattan Cafe's sake, this is nothing...
choice_data_list: Because I want to do whatever I can.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, in that case,
may I ask a favor of you?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"There is a ritual I must perform tomorrow.
It is... of utmost importance."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, it's not something I can do alone...
So I was hoping... you might lend me a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I shall begin the ritual...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: First, please take a deep breath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The crisp, clear air fills every corner of my body.
I feel as though my head has cleared up a bit..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Next... let us head further inside.
No need to rush; we'll take our time sightseeing, nice and easy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And where we arrived was...
a retro general store nestled deep within the woods.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I bought a cypress sachet.
Please take a deep breath and take in the scent...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is also necessary for the ritual, so...
choice_data_list: Phew... What a refreshing, soothing scent.
Phew... What a refreshing, soothing scent.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Purification through the footbath...
They put salt in this one, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that's why. It feels like it warms me up even more than an ordinary bath.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And also... once we get back to the academy, let's put on the finishing touches in our usual room...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following her instructions, I headed to the empty classroom Manhattan Cafe used. And there—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Welcome...
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is... something like formal ritual attire.
Now then, come this way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Manhattan Cafe, I took a seat.
A teacup filled with freshly poured tea had been set before me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This tea will purify you from within...
Please, drink up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a sip of the tea as offered.
Just as the deep savoriness and warmth brought a sense of relief...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Excuse me from behind.
I shall now infuse you with "Ki" for the finishing touch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap, tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe moved behind me and started tapping my shoulders.
The rhythmic patter and vibration...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later...
I give my shoulders a roll, and—
choice_data_list: Amazing, my body feels so light...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Your shoulders were awfully stiff, Trainer.
After all, you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —Because... you looked tired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I may have been slightly overworking myself lately.
Come to think of it, strolling through the forest, soaking in a footbath... it feels like it's been a while since I enjoyed such recreation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't accepted her request,
I wouldn't have reflected on my own situation like this.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I just wanted to heal you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because today is—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because it's Valentine's Day.
choice_data_list: ...In that case, maybe I'll rest here a little longer.
I'll take better care of my body from now on.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In that case... the other day,
I managed to get some delicious rice crackers...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take it easy today
while we eat that..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...And Trainer-san.
Here, take this...”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's... like an amulet for good health.
Please keep it close to you for a while...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: To keep from getting 'Exhausted' again...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I recommend a coffee bath...
I hear it helps relieve fatigue and has antibacterial properties...
choice_data_list: I see, maybe I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, by all means...
